IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P#7892 triggered — model-serving-prod:gamma-canary elevated 5xx rate in eu-west-1 (errors spiking ~18% over baseline)
Emma Chen: seeing same in dashboards, tail latencies up too. Customer-impacting?
Raj Patel: I'm oncall and looking. Any correlated deploys? @DeployBot did a canary push recently?
DeployBot: deploy 2026-03-14_21:42:11 -> gamma-canary v3.7.2 rolled to 5% in eu-west-1 (auto-canary).
Lena Ortiz: I just pulled logs — model rejects on KV cache misses, OOM-ish patterns on a subset of hosts. Might be quantized kernel mismatch.
Mike H: Support flagged 3 customers complaining about 502s from the API in EU. Not widespread but definitely affecting heavy conversational sessions.
Sophie G: tagging as P1 for now. We need to minimize customer impact while we triage.
Emma Chen: plan: 1) pull traffic off gamma-canary in eu-west-1 2) slice heavy keys to limit blast radius 3) fallback to stable variant v3.6.8 if needed. Starting now.
Raj Patel: executing soft evict — reducing gamma-canary weight to 0 in routing table for eu-west-1. Handoff to me after changes.
Raj Patel: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://internal.api.redwood/v1/routing/update -d '{"model":"gamma","variant":"canary","region":"eu-west-1","weight":0}'`
Emma Chen: applied. Canaries now show 0% in eu-west-1. Traffic should route to nearest compatible variant.
Lena Ortiz: checking model fallback — policy shows fallback to stable-2026-03-01 (v3.6.8) in eu-west-1. Good.
Mike H: customer reports dropping, some recovery starting. Still seeing a few 502s for long sessions.
Raj Patel: next, implement keywise rate-slicing for heavy customers to protect shared pool. Suggest `slice_by: customer_id`, `limit: 75r/s` for top 50 keys.
Emma Chen: creating a temporary quota policy:
```
{
  "policy_name":"emergency-slice-eu-west-1",
  "scope":{"region":"eu-west-1","model":"gamma"},
  "slice_by":"customer_id",
  "default_limit_rps":20,
  "overrides":[{"customer_id":"cust:alpha","limit_rps":75},{"customer_id":"cust:beta","limit_rps":50}]
}
```
Raj Patel: applied policy via admin UI. `PUT /admin/quotas/emergency-slice-eu-west-1` returned 200.
DeployBot: routing change confirmed, quota policy deployed to control plane (commit d9f3a4).
Lena Ortiz: logs show error rate dropping on hosts that previously had OOM churn. KV miss-to-error ratio improving.
Sophie G: status update for customers: "We're seeing partial recovery; we've temporarily routed traffic off the canary variant and applied per-customer rate limits to stabilize service. Our SREs continue to monitor." Thoughts?
Mike H: send that out and include guidance for affected customers to restart long-running sessions (they'll clear the stale KV).
Emma Chen: next step — decide whether to fully retire gamma-canary or re-run quantization tests. I propose to keep canary shelved for 24h and collect regression traces, then either promote a patched canary or roll forward a rebuilt quant variant.
Raj Patel: +1. Marking canary as "shelved" in runtime control and adding an incident tag. Also creating a post-incident ticket for model eng to repro locally with failing host snapshots.
Lena Ortiz: grabbing heap dumps and full trace for hosts with highest error counts. Will try local reproduce with v3.7.2 quant kernels.
Sophie G: are there any customers still impacted? Mike?
Mike H: two heavy customers still have intermittent errors but much reduced. I've opened high-priority tickets and linked this incident.
Emma Chen: handing off monitoring to Raj for the next 2 hours, then Sophie will coordinate customer comms and follow-ups.
Raj Patel: I'm on watch. Alert thresholds lowered (5xx > 1%) and paging enabled for any recurrence.
DeployBot: PagerDuty P#7892 acknowledged by Raj Patel.
Emma Chen: final note — document mitigation steps in the incident playbook, include exact curl commands and admin UI steps so runbook matches reality. Also add an action item for model team: add preflight quant smoke tests for eu image sizes.
Sophie G: creating follow-up ticket INC-2026-345 with required assignees.
Mike H: will update impacted customers with the recovery note in 15m.
Raj Patel: last check — error rate in eu-west-1 down to 1.8% (from 18%). Latency back to baseline for safe variant. Holding for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: P#7892 resolved by manual mitigation steps (shelved gamma-canary, deployed emergency-slice-eu-west-1)."
